title: GTA 6 file size: EA's 'Don't Delete' Madden 27 pop-up
description: GTA 6 file size is the joke behind EA's 'Don't Delete' Madden NFL 27 pop-up, which urges players to keep the game before GTA 6 launches November 19.

body.text: The GTA 6 file size is now part of a very public tug-of-war over console storage. According to IGN, EA has added a "Don't Delete!" pop-up to Madden NFL 27, and players read it as a plea not to wipe the game to make room for Grand Theft Auto 6. It matters because it shows how much of the industry is bracing for Rockstar's launch.
What the Madden NFL 27 pop-up says

Reports of the notice appeared over the weekend, with CharlieIntel sharing what they found online. EA does not mention GTA 6 by name. But the message uses familiar pink-and-purple colours and sun-soaked palm trees, which makes the target hard to miss.

The text is written like a heist transmission. It calls the target locked, says the crew is assembling and tells players to wait for a signal from "our insider on 11/17." In plain terms, it asks users to keep Madden installed because an update lands on Tuesday, November 17.
Early screenshots also showed a typo, "awating signal" instead of "awaiting signal." IGN says newer posts suggest it was fixed quickly.
GTA 6 file size and EA's earlier jab

This was not EA's first nudge. According to IGN, the official Madden X account posted on November 10 about an update on November 18. It said, "Don't let 210GB get between you and Your League." IGN describes that line as a reference to GTA 6's massive file size.

Note that the two posts give different update dates, November 17 in the pop-up and November 18 in the tweet, and IGN reports both without reconciling them. Madden NFL 27 itself launched on August 13, 2026 for PC, Nintendo Switch 2, PS5 and Xbox Series X/S.
Fans mostly found it funny, though some felt EA was begging. IGN quotes several reactions:

items: One Reddit user said the message means EA is "terrified of GTA VI's launch."
Another Reddit reply imagined EA pleading, "PLEASE DON'T DELETE MADDEN TO CLEAR SPACE FOR GTA."
An X user wrote that EA begging players not to delete Madden is "so funny."
Others replied to EA's account saying they had already deleted Madden for GTA 6 space.

body.text: GTA 6 release date and what to watch

According to IGN, GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X/S. The outlet says the game, a decade in the making and tipped for the biggest launch ever, has led many other games to clear the calendar.

Next up is the Madden update on November 17 and whether other live-service publishers make similar moves. For anyone with a limited console drive, the real question is simple: which games stay installed once GTA 6 arrives?

faqs.q: What is the EA 'Don't Delete' message in Madden NFL 27?
faqs.a: It is an in-game pop-up that asks players not to uninstall Madden NFL 27 and promises a new update on Tuesday, November 17. According to IGN, it never names GTA 6, but its pink-and-purple colours and palm trees point to Rockstar's game.

faqs.q: What is the GTA 6 release date?
faqs.a: IGN reports that GTA 6 launches for PS5 and Xbox Series X/S on November 19. The article says that date falls this week.

faqs.q: How big is GTA 6 according to EA's Madden post?
faqs.a: EA's Madden account wrote, "Don't let 210GB get between you and Your League," in a November 10 post, which IGN says refers to GTA 6's massive file size. IGN does not separately confirm the number.

sources.title: EA Adds 'Don't Delete' Message to Madden NFL 27 in Bid to Keep Players From Making Room Ahead of GTA 6
